ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The central-left part of the figure is an urban area represented by a grid; outside the figure there are contour lines, marked with values such as 160 meters, 170 meters, and 180 meters; the river is in a curved-line shape and passes through near the urban area in the figure. A, B, C, and D are distributed around the urban area, with B located near lower contour lines, and C located beside the river and near the side with higher contour lines. Then reason: The flow direction of a river should be from high places to low places, so it can flow from the higher-elevation river section near C to the lower-elevation river section near B. A waterworks should be built outside the city, near the river, and upstream of the city, in order to obtain a relatively clean water source. Among the four places, C meets the conditions of “upstream of the river, outside the city, near water”, so it is the most suitable for building a waterworks.

raw_record.question_text:
Read the schematic diagram of a certain urban area and answer the question.

<image1>

Among the four places A, B, C, and D in the figure, which location is most suitable for building a waterworks?

method.method_draft: First describe the map features: identify the city, river, contour values, and the positions of 甲、乙、丙、丁. Then infer the river-flow direction from the contour labels: water moves from the higher-elevation reach near 丙 toward the lower-elevation reach near 乙. Apply the siting rule for a waterworks: choose an outside-city, riverside, upstream position with cleaner raw water. This selects 丙.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中中央偏左是用网格表示的城区；图外有等高线，标注了160米、170米、180米等数值；河流呈弯曲线状从图中穿过城区附近，甲、乙、丙、丁分布在城区周边，其中乙位于较低等高线附近，丙位于河流旁且靠近较高等高线一侧。再推理：河流流向应由高处流向低处，因此可由丙附近较高海拔河段流向乙附近较低海拔河段。自来水厂应建在城市外、靠近河流、位于城市上游的位置，以取得较清洁的水源。四处中丙符合“河流上游、城外近水”的条件，所以最适宜建自来水厂。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Uses the hydrological/topographic route: infer river flow direction from contour elevations, then apply the upstream-water-quality rule for a waterworks. This is the most direct map-reading solution.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the legend: the hatched polygon is the urban district, the wavy thick line is the river, and the thin lines with 160、170、180 are contour lines. Locate the four candidate labels: 甲 near/inside the northern edge of the built-up area, 乙 on the upper-right river reach near lower elevation, 丙 on the east/southeast side of the city beside the river, 丁 to the southwest. Use the contour values around the river to see that elevation is higher near the 丙/southern reach and lower toward the 乙/northeastern reach, so the river flows generally from the 丙 side toward the 乙 side.
planner_metadata.text_role: Read that the task asks which of 甲、乙、丙、丁 is most suitable for building a 自来水厂.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: A 自来水厂 should be placed near a reliable water source and preferably upstream of the city so that the intake water is cleaner and less affected by urban pollution. Rivers flow from higher contour elevations to lower contour elevations.

method.method_draft: First describe the visible land-use and candidate positions on the sketch. Then eliminate unsuitable locations: discard 甲 because it is in/too close to the built-up district; discard 乙 because it is on the lower/downstream side relative to the city and thus less favorable for clean intake; discard 丁 because it is less convenient to the urban supply area and not the best riverside upstream site.
